title: Offline Policy Evaluation Lab
dek: Counterledger is an offline policy evaluator I built in Python: it estimates how a new decision policy would have done from records of past decisions, without trying it for real. This page rebuilds its importance-sampling core in your browser and tests whether an apparent gain survives three checks.
summary: Scores a new decision policy on records of past decisions, then tests whether its apparent win survives a control, a reward change and a support audit.
